concerns.location: plan.md:Phase Overview & FR/SC Mapping table – Phase 5 row
concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑019 (random‑noise baseline dataset) is listed in the FR column for Phase 5 but the plan’s description only creates two control‑perturbation datasets (correlation‑perturbation and marginal‑perturbation). No step generates the independent random‑noise baseline required by FR‑019, leaving this requirement unaddressed.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase Overview & FR/SC Mapping table – Phase 1 row
concerns.text: The plan references FR‑080 (encoding‑consistency) in Phase 1, but FR‑080 does not exist in the specification. This introduces a plan element that has no corresponding spec requirement.
